title: Frigidaire Gallery — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Frigidaire Gallery.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "More Performance, Less Price." Frigidaire Gallery sits between base Frigidaire and Frigidaire Professional — it is where the sweet spot lives. Air Fry in ranges, smudge-proof stainless, True Convection ovens, and the OrbitClean dishwasher spray arm. Gallery gives customers 80% of premium features at 60% of premium pricing. This is the tier that wins the most cross-shops.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Budget-conscious buyers who still want modern features. Customers cross-shopping Samsung/LG who are open to alternatives.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Frigidaire Gallery:

• Air Fry built into every range — no extra gadgets needed

• Smudge-Proof stainless resists fingerprints without special coatings

• OrbitClean spray arm in dishwashers covers 4x more area than standard

• True Convection with precise temperature management for even baking

• Gallery pricing undercuts Samsung/LG/GE Profile while matching most features
